There are some things to clarify here:
1. This is regular procedure, explained on our website, and not an irregular requirement. 
2. An affidavit (that was mentioned here in another comment) would only be accepted if official certificates are genuinely unattainable, meaning that country does not issue those certificates at all. The fact that you checked with the embassy does not mean the certificates don't exist, maybe just that the embassy cannot issue them (at any rate, embassy certificates are usually not approved anyway). So you should check if you are able to issue those certificates at the countries themselves, for example by travelling there or via power of attorney to your representative. It's very unlikely countries don't issue a police certificate to past residents.
